programme.title: Sacricfies of the Heart
programme.desc: Emotional family drama. A hotshot city lawyer (Melissa Gilbert, ʻLittle House on the Prairieʼ) returns to the family farm run by her older brother and her estranged father, who is suffering from Alzheimerʼs disease. As his health and memory deteriorate, she reaches a new understanding about what drove her mother to commit suicide.

programme.title: The Pledge/A Gunfighter's Pledge
programme.desc: Ex-lawman Matt Austin (Luke Perry) accidentally kills an innocent man (Alex Paez) while hunting an outlaw who killed his family. He pledges to the dying man that he will take his body to his sister Amaya (Jaclyn DeSantis). Austin wrestles with the idea of telling her he caused the death, but is faced with bigger battles once at the farm. There he gets involved with land baron Horn (C. Thomas Howell), who is trying to take Amaya's land. Their lives are more intertwined than he thought, when he takes on Horn and discovers that Horn has hired the man he was looking for all along.

programme.title: New Worlds
programme.desc: King Charles gives Hardwick Angelica's land for new clay-pits but denies him the house until he has captured Abe. Aware that Angelica's faithful servants will be condemned to work in the clay-pits Abe goes to London to seek out his father's old friend Colonel Sidney and they plot to assassinate the king but they are caught and imprisoned. Beth's ship is wrecked on the shore at Massachusetts and she is adopted by the Wawanaki tribe, led by Masca, with whom she mutually falls in love and goes native. In Boston Hope marries Cresswell to the dismay of Ned, who has returned to the New World. He begins an affair with her but are discovered by Cresswell who forbids them to meet on pain of death. In order to clear the natives off their land Cresswell , acting in collusion with Kohn Hawkins, makes a present of blankets to the Wawanaki but they are deliberately infected with small-pox. Lacking any immunity many of the tribe, including Masca, die. Realizing that Cresswell has deliberately murdered them she stabs him in the presence of Ned.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 3: Sing Me A Murder
programme.desc: Murder is something to sing about when Mystery Woman Samantha Kinsey-an expert in pulp fiction, and increasingly proficient when it comes to real-life crime-untangles a record-breaking murder. Mystery Woman bookshop owner, Samantha Kinsey, has offered to host a charity concert for a once-famous folk-rock trio out to recapture their old fame flame. But sweet success hits the ultimate sour note when the band's promoter is found murdered in his hotel room. Sam and her partner in crime, Philby, investigate, digging up deadly secrets of private indiscretions, professional greed, and personal vengeance that put a twisted spin on fame and fortune-and bring a whole new meaning to a Top Ten hit.

programme.title: The Colour of Magic
programme.desc: Constantly failing at the Unseen University, the wizard Rincewind is given the task by the Patrician of looking after the Discworld's first tourist: Twoflower. The main character is the incompetent and cynical wizard Rincewind, who involuntarily finds himself as a guide to the naive tourist, Twoflower. After they are forced to flee from the city of Ankh-Morpork after a terrible fire they are sent on a journey across the disc which is unknowingly being controlled by a board game being played by the Gods. They meet two barbarians on their way out of morpork, Bravd and Weasel. After their visit to Wyrmberg, the upside-down mountain which is home to dragons that only exist in the imagination, their journey leads them to the country of Krull, perched on the very edge of the Discworld where they are thrown off the edge of the Disc due to the Krullian's urge to find out the gender of Great A'Tuin (the turtle which is swimming through space with four elephants resting the Disc on top).

programme.title: The Colour of Magic
programme.desc: As Rincewind is hounded across the Discworld by the Wizards of Unseen University, he is helped by Twoflower the Tourist, his luggage and Cohen the Barbarian. The main character is the incompetent and cynical wizard Rincewind, who involuntarily finds himself as a guide to the naive tourist, Twoflower. programme.title: Lone Rider
programme.desc: Bobby Hattaway (Lou Diamond Phillips), an honored soldier, returns home after the American Civil War to find his father's (Stacy Keach) formerly prosperous store now dangerously in debt to the town's ruthless leader, and Bobby's childhood friend, Stu Croker (Vincent Spano). Bobby will now face off against his former friend to take control from Stu.

programme.title: Claire
programme.desc: Loosely based on a Japanese fairytale, an elderly male couple on a farm in the 1920's South find a little girl from the moon inside an ear of corn and raise her as their own.

programme.title: Word of Honor
programme.desc: Prompted by a just-published book that holds ex-lieutenant Ben Tyson accountable for a hushed-up massacre committed by his platoon in a Hue hospital 30 years before, the army recalls Tyson to stand trial for murder. Tyson, confronted by an army authority anxious to save its own face, an embarrassed federal government, and a threatened marriage, and entangled, furthermore, in his own past lives and present sense of guilt, must call on all his cleverness and his own inner toughness to fight his case.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 9: Oh Baby
programme.desc: Crime drama with Kellie Martin. A couple accused of a murder go on the run, leaving their baby with bookshop owner and amateur sleuth Samantha Kinsey. Can she look after the child and solve the case?

programme.title: Wyvern
programme.desc: The small Alaskan town of Beaver Mills is located just north of the Arctic Circle, meaning that the sun does not set during the summer solstice. As the town prepares for its annual celebration of this event, a wyvern is awakened by the melting of the ice caps, and attacks a fisherman. Jake (Nick Chinlund), a handyman fixing the cafe where a waitress named Claire (Erin Karpluk) works, hurts his hand and David (David Lewis (Canadian actor)), the town's doctor, examines it. While driving back to town, David is attacked by the wyvern. The next morning, Sheriff Dawson (John Shaw) and Jake hear gunshots and find Haas (Barry Corbin), a redneck attacked by the wyvern. Colonel (Don S. Davis), who has seen the Wyvern, goes to town to warn the citizens; but they disbelieve him, and he goes to kill it. Dawson radios to his Deputy Susie (Elaine Miles) to watch the town, but fails to convey his meaning. Dawson finds his friend dead, and returns. At the town, the wyvern kills Susie and several other people. Jake, Claire, Haas, and the eccentric Edna (Karen Austin) take shelter in the cafe. Later, Vinyl (Tinsel Korey), who runs the town's radio, and Farley (Simon Longmore), another citizen, hide in the cafe. Sheriff Dawson is killed by the wyvern. Jake and Claire track the wyvern into the woods, where they find the Colonel, and discover the wyvern is killing anyone on the Interstate. Farley is injured trying to get supplies. The wyvern then uses David, still alive, as bait to draw people from the cafe. Jake goes to rescue him, and Farley distracts the wyvern to save them, but is eaten. David tells the group the Wyvern has eggs, and dies of his injuries. The survivors decide to electrify the nest, but the wyvern kills Haas. Jake takes a truck left on the side of the road and, using the eggs as bait, kills the wyvern. Jake, Claire, Colonel, Vinyl, and Edna try again to radio for help.

programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead
programme.desc: The eighth season of Fear begins after the conclusion of Season 7, when Morgan's (Lennie James) and Madison's (Kim Dickens) hopes to rescue Mo from PADRE did not go as planned. Now, Morgan, Madison and the others they brought to the island are living under PADRE's cynical rule. With our characters demoralized and dejected, the task of reigniting belief in a better world rests with the person Morgan and Madison set out to rescue in the first place -- Morgan's daughter, Mo.

programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Disenfranchised by economic catastrophe & the fall of a nation, destitute young women & children are left behind and become prey to the underworld. They are a desirable commodity in a billion dollar industry where human beings are bought and sold. In the Ukraine, sixteen-year-old Nadia (Laurence Leboeuf, The Secret) is seduced by the promises of a modeling agency. She runs away from home and disappears. In Southeast Asia, the vacation of a middle-class American couple turns into a nightmare when their twelve-year-old daughter, Annie (Sarah-Jeanne Labrosse, 15/Love), is kidnapped and sold to a brothel. In Prague, Helena (Isabelle Blais, The Barbarian Invasions), a struggling single mother is swept off her feet by the advances of a wealthy businessman. But it's a trap and she too "disappears". In Romania, an orphaned seventeen year old Katerina (Anna Hopkins,Thunderstone) vanishes after meeting her fiancé, whom she met online. The horrific destiny of each victim is tied to a sex-trafficking ring. It's the job of Kate Morozov (Oscar and Golden Globe winner Mira Sorvino, Mighty Aphrodite), a detective for Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) to help find the men responsible. But first she knows she must win the faith of the victims who have learned firsthand the futility of trust. While Annie's parents join forces with Tom Halloran (Terry Haig, The Aviator) and a renegade worker for an NGO, scouting a child-prostitution ring, Nadia's grief-stricken father Viktor is embarking on his own personal hunt to find the men responsible. From a torture chamber in the suburbs of Queens to the flesh-peddlers of Russia the hunt is on, revealing a shocking conspiracy of global proportions. Featuring Emmy and Golden Globe winner Donald Sutherland, (The Italian Job) and Robert Carlyle (The Full Monty) Human Trafficking is at once a gripping government procedural, a cautionary tale of an international scourge, and one of the most compulsively important thrillers of the ye.

programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Human Trafficking is an American crime drama series dealing with the terrible crime of selling people into the sex slave industry. The series follows an American agent, Kate Morozov, as she goes undercover to investigate the cases of dead prostitutes suspecting they are victims of trafficking. Meanwhile, three young women from different parts of the world are forced to become sex workers, as part of the international network led by Sergei Karpovich. Helena, a single mother from Prague has a chance to testify.

programme.title: The Five People You Meet In Heaven
programme.desc: Social. American social drama, produced in 2004. An accident sends Eddie in Heaven! While there, he meets five people who explain to him what the key moments in his life were, through which the real meaning of his life is recorded.

programme.title: A Deadly Encounter
programme.desc: Thriller. After working late one night, restaurant hostess Joanne Sanders (Laura Leighton, ʻMelrose Placeʼ) accidentally cuts up a car on the highway, which leads the other driver (Alain Goulem, ʻ18 to Lifeʼ) to stalk and harass her, determined to exact his revenge.

programme.title: An Unexpected Love
programme.desc: An unhappily married housewife and mother of two children (Leslie Hope) seperates from her husband and gets a new job where she developes a mutual attraction to her female boss (Wendy Crewson).

programme.title: Drive Time Murders
programme.desc: Drama with Cameron Daddo. A handsome attorney and his gossip columnist wife who host their own radio show, and also solve murder mysteries dig into a murder of a homeless lady.

programme.title: New Worlds
programme.desc: With Cresswell dead Hope and Ned are free to marry. They are, however, suspicious of John Hawkins' part in distributing the infected blankets and argue with him. As a result he has a heart attack and dies, asking Ned to take over his business though Ned is more concerned with helping Beth to hide Hope. Abe is visited in Oxford jail but Angelica's maid Agnes, who gives him a potion which simulates death and his 'corpse' is thrown into the plague pit, from where Agnes and her grandfather Adam rescue him. However Colonel Sidney is executed but Ned manages to obtain the colonel's writings, advocating freedom from Britain for the colonies, which he has smuggled into Boston. He and Hope are organizing a meeting for like-minded young colonists but they are interrupted by armed troopers who shoot and kill them. Beth returns to England to see the insurgents who took part in Monmouth's unsuccessful rebellion, being put to death. These include Agnes and Adam but she is reunited with Abe who has managed to escape.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 4: Vision Of A Murder
programme.desc: Sam lands a job photographing a new spa in Southern California for their brochure and brings her best friend Cassie along to enjoy some pampering. When one of the guests staying at the upscale retreat turns up dead, Sam is once again on the trail of a murderer. As the investigation progresses, Sam uncovers a scam that the spa Dr was testing unapproved drugs on the patrons.. filler implants, etc. without the patients' informed consent.

programme.title: DC 9/11: Time of Crisis
programme.desc: Gideon Banks lost his wife Liz and son Simon in a horrific car accident some twenty years ago. At the time of the accident he was involved in something called the Neural Archiving Project - NAP for short. The technology was developed to create smart computers - transferring human engrams to computers. The company eventually gave up on the technology, but Gideon didn't. After years of quietly perfecting it, he built a small robot, from parts he stole from Concorde Robotics, where he now works. Zoe, Gideon's niece, discovers Gideon's secret, the robot contains actual neural engrams from the real Simon. She becomes worried not only about Gideon but also about the robot that sounds and acts a lot like her little cousin used to.

programme.title: Redeemer
programme.desc: A writer is touched by the story of a former Black Panther who seams to have been wrongfully convicted to life imprisonment 20 years ago. The writer decides to try to help the now middle-aged convict get exonerated.

programme.title: Acceptance
programme.desc: Paul confesses his feelings to Rosanna. He gets Rosanna to admit to her feelings for him but she insists she cant think about anything but Cabots welfare for now. She agrees to leave the door open between them. Meanwhile, Barbara goes to James to let him know that his plan for Jordan and Rosanna is falling apart. She indirectly asks James for his help in making sure Jordan and Rosanna stay together. Soon after, Cabot mysteriously appears in the middle of Fairwinds, when neither Paul nor Rosanna put him there! A new clue appears in the paper and Chris, Alison, Emily and Susan are all trying to figure it out. When Nancy cant help, Alison goes to Aaron. He agrees to help her, and Alison doesnt tell him about her engagement. Meanwhile, Bob helps Chris with the clue. Chris hurries to the dance studio where the key is apparently hidden and finds a tango lesson underway. Emily and Chris agree to take a tango lesson in order to get to the key. They are dancing together when Alison and Aaron arrive outside. Alison is about to go in when Aaron notices her ring. Tom confronts Margo about the compact and she tells him its not hers. Tom asks her one more time if it was only a kiss between her and Doc. Margo confirms the lie and they agree to try to move on. Jill has overheard everything. She confronts Margo after Tom leaves, promising to keep quiet about what she has witnessed on one condition. Meanwhile, Ben tells Jessica hell agree to in Vitro. At the hospital, Jessica bumps into Doc and admits shes been too hard on him. Then Dr. Schilling informs her she isnt a candidate for in vitro because shes already pregnant! Doc looks on as Ben hugs Jessica to celebrate the good news.

programme.title: Audrey's Rain
programme.desc: Heart-warming drama about a bitter, sharp-tongued spinster, whose future looks bleakwhen she is saddled with raising her nephew and niece after her sister commits suicide. Audrey resents that her family has robbed her of a life of her own, but when her childhood sweetheart reappears on the scene, her life takes an unexpected turn.

programme.title: The Colt
programme.desc: In 1864, an American Civil War troop struggles to survive when young Union (American Civil War) soldier Jim Rabb (Ryan Merriman) discovers that his mare has given birth to a Colt (horse). A superior officer orders Jim to shoot the foal because it may become a burden, but Jim - seeing the colt as a sign of hope and a reminder of the beauty of life - refuses. The colt remains with the men as they battle. When Confederacy (American Civil War)s overtake the camp and steal the colt, Jim must risk his life retrieving it.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 6: Redemption
programme.desc: A rare first edition from a pioneer author goes missing in the mystery novels-specialized Kinsey bookshop during remodeling by the local firm of Tyler Dell, who recently lost his father, a Vietnam veteran. Retired English teacher Jim Carter, who overheard everything, is murdered shortly after a row in Reverend Tucker's homeless shelter Haven with aggressive lush Murphy. Rude police chief Connors isn't up to an investigation while the killer keeps sniping, so the bookstore's armchair sleuths duo does it alone, starting from a lacquered box left by Jim for his illegitimate daughter, who never even knew his name. It starts a set of cues, slowly unraveling a grim intrigue starting during a 1965 US illegal intrusion into Red Khmer territory.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 10: In the Shadows
programme.desc: While searching for a KGB double agent who was about to be exposed by another Russian spy-turned-successful author, mystery bookstore owner Samantha Kinsey and her secretive friend and store manager, Philby are thrust into the murderous world of international espionage.

programme.title: Arthur Hailey's: Detective
programme.desc: Detective Sergeant Malcolm Ainslie, a Catholic priest turned distinguished investigator for the police, has agreed to hear the confession of a convicted serial killer sentenced to death in a just a matter of hours. What he promises to reveal to Ainslie is the truth behind the crimes and the reason he confessed to the one crime Ainslie doesn't even believe he committed. What unfolds between the two men is a serpentine trail into both men's pasts based on the bestseller from master storyteller Arthur Hailey.

programme.title: Out of the Ashes
programme.desc: A Holocaust survivor heads for America where she dreams of starting a new life, but finds it difficult to put the past behind her, especially when she's forced to relive the nightmare of Auschwitz.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 5: Game Time
programme.desc: Bright youngest graduate Randy (Stinky) Lawrence convinces Samantha to promote his brilliant murder video game in the bookstore in exchange for his help in convincing "old friend" Donald Fiske, a celebrated author, to do a signing session there. To Randy's surprise, it works, but Fiske is poisoned after slipping out angry. Randy is Chief Connors's only suspect. Despite obvious repeated lies, Samantha sets out to prove his innocence. Fiske's greedy ex, Jody, pretends to have convinced him to remarry, yet she never even allowed their teenage son Cameron to set foot in Donald's fine home.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 7: At First Sight
programme.desc: After dating hot doctor Ben, "Mystery Woman" Samantha becomes curious about her family medical history so she sets out upstate to fictitious small town; Whiptail, California in search of her birth mother. Samantha finds her unfortunately she has just been arrested as a suspect in a murder. Murder and mystery follow Samantha wherever she goes.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 8: Wild West Mystery
programme.desc: Former Red River TV series star Clint Lawson's Wild West show is in town, the prize act in the annual festival, which the sponsoring bookshop is presiding over. He strains a leg due to a sabotaged saddle strap. His stand-in, Dogie, is fatally shot while starring in his place, so who was the intended target? Evidence seems to pile up against Clint, so the chief simply jails him without further investigation. However, the bookshop sleuths team digs up dirty secrets from their past and that of other show cast, such as ex-con announcer Jeb Fletcher, Clint's ex-lover Annie whom he promised a movie part like Strother Elam, and Zeke Foster, who secretly deals in illegitimate Red River memorabilia.

programme.title: Monte Walsh
programme.desc: Montelius "Monte" Walsh (Tom Selleck) is an aging cowboy facing the final days of the Wild West era. He and his friend Chet Rollins (Keith Carradine), another long-time cowhand, work at whatever ranch work comes their way, but "nothing they can't do from a horse". Their lives are divided between months on the range and the occasional trip into town. Camaraderie and competition with the other cowboys fill their days. They seek work and take a job at the ranch of Cal Brennan (William Devane), where they meet an old friend, Shorty Austin (George Eads), another ranch hand.

programme.desc: Denise Richards plays Lauren, a divorced wedding-planner who falls for the groom-to-be (Dean Cain).

programme.desc: Three tornadoes converge to wreak havoc on Chicago, disrupting the power grid and creating the worst super-storm in history.

programme.title: Wyvern
programme.desc: The small Alaskan town of Beaver Mills is located just north of the Arctic Circle, meaning that the sun does not set during the summer solstice. As the town prepares for its annual celebration of this event, a wyvern is awakened by the melting of the ice caps, and attacks a fisherman. Jake (Nick Chinlund), a handyman fixing the cafe where a waitress named Claire (Erin Karpluk) works, hurts his hand and David (David Lewis (Canadian actor)), the town's doctor, examines it. While driving back to town, David is attacked by the wyvern. The next morning, Sheriff Dawson (John Shaw) and Jake hear gunshots and find Haas (Barry Corbin), a redneck attacked by the wyvern. Colonel (Don S. Davis), who has seen the Wyvern, goes to town to warn the citizens; but they disbelieve him, and he goes to kill it. Dawson radios to his Deputy Susie (Elaine Miles) to watch the town, but fails to convey his meaning. Dawson finds his friend dead, and returns. At the town, the wyvern kills Susie and several other people. Jake, Claire, Haas, and the eccentric Edna (Karen Austin) take shelter in the cafe. Later, Vinyl (Tinsel Korey), who runs the town's radio, and Farley (Simon Longmore), another citizen, hide in the cafe. Sheriff Dawson is killed by the wyvern. Jake and Claire track the wyvern into the woods, where they find the Colonel, and discover the wyvern is killing anyone on the Interstate. Farley is injured trying to get supplies. The wyvern then uses David, still alive, as bait to draw people from the cafe. Jake goes to rescue him, and Farley distracts the wyvern to save them, but is eaten. David tells the group the Wyvern has eggs, and dies of his injuries. The survivors decide to electrify the nest, but the wyvern kills Haas. Jake takes a truck left on the side of the road and, using the eggs as bait, kills the wyvern. Jake, Claire, Colonel, Vinyl, and Edna try again to radio for help.

programme.title: Deadly Isolation
programme.desc: Crafty Patrick Carlson and his violent accomplice Kyle Mumford have hidden in the woods up north for months after pulling off a major diamonds robbery in San Fracisco. They hoped to collect the loot from a third accomplice, who says it must be with Susan, the widow of professor Ron Mandaway, who probably hid it before committing suicide. Patrick adopts the false identity of Jeff Watkins, a retired entrepreneur, who supposedly had a yachting accident, so she'll take him into her luxury island villa. Jeff's charms win her confidence, but can't find the diamonds, and she seems unaware. Kyle loses his patience, and local sheriff Kirby Grantham, who regularly pays Susan a friendly visit, becomes a problem when his deputy finds Jeff's identity most suspicious.

programme.title: Close Up
programme.desc: Exploring the lives and careers of the well-known and famous from the worlds of music and film, these 26-minute long biographical portraits provide a pictorial insight into the background, careers and personal lives of some of the twentieth-century's best known personalities and iconic faces.

programme.title: Zoom In
programme.desc: Zoom In is a TV series that helps us to peep into the inside of the magic process of film making. It is an exciting trip to the hottest movies production. Get the insiders' look at the budget and the crew all in just seven minutes. Top actors and actresses, writers, producers and directors share a part of their secrets about their job. See with your own eyes the action scenes from shooting and find out what it is really like to make a movie.

programme.title: Drive Time Murders
programme.desc: Drama with Cameron Daddo. A handsome attorney and his gossip columnist wife who host their own radio show, and also solve murder mysteries dig into a murder of a homeless lady.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 9: Oh Baby
programme.desc: Crime drama with Kellie Martin. A couple accused of a murder go on the run, leaving their baby with bookshop owner and amateur sleuth Samantha Kinsey. Can she look after the child and solve the case?

programme.title: Mystery Woman 6: Redemption
programme.desc: A rare first edition from a pioneer author goes missing in the mystery novels-specialized Kinsey bookshop during remodeling by the local firm of Tyler Dell, who recently lost his father, a Vietnam veteran. Retired English teacher Jim Carter, who overheard everything, is murdered shortly after a row in Reverend Tucker's homeless shelter Haven with aggressive lush Murphy. Rude police chief Connors isn't up to an investigation while the killer keeps sniping, so the bookstore's armchair sleuths duo does it alone, starting from a lacquered box left by Jim for his illegitimate daughter, who never even knew his name. It starts a set of cues, slowly unraveling a grim intrigue starting during a 1965 US illegal intrusion into Red Khmer territory.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 10: In the Shadows
programme.desc: While searching for a KGB double agent who was about to be exposed by another Russian spy-turned-successful author, mystery bookstore owner Samantha Kinsey and her secretive friend and store manager, Philby are thrust into the murderous world of international espionage.

programme.title: Life on Liberty Street
programme.desc: Heartwarming drama with Annabeth Gish. After losing her husband and job, a single mother's life changes unexpectedly while working at a care centre for brain trauma patients.

programme.title: The Colt
programme.desc: In 1864, an American Civil War troop struggles to survive when young Union (American Civil War) soldier Jim Rabb (Ryan Merriman) discovers that his mare has given birth to a Colt (horse). A superior officer orders Jim to shoot the foal because it may become a burden, but Jim - seeing the colt as a sign of hope and a reminder of the beauty of life - refuses. The colt remains with the men as they battle. When Confederacy (American Civil War)s overtake the camp and steal the colt, Jim must risk his life retrieving it.

programme.title: The Colour of Magic
programme.desc: Constantly failing at the Unseen University, the wizard Rincewind is given the task by the Patrician of looking after the Discworld's first tourist: Twoflower. The main character is the incompetent and cynical wizard Rincewind, who involuntarily finds himself as a guide to the naive tourist, Twoflower. After they are forced to flee from the city of Ankh-Morpork after a terrible fire they are sent on a journey across the disc which is unknowingly being controlled by a board game being played by the Gods. They meet two barbarians on their way out of morpork, Bravd and Weasel. After their visit to Wyrmberg, the upside-down mountain which is home to dragons that only exist in the imagination, their journey leads them to the country of Krull, perched on the very edge of the Discworld where they are thrown off the edge of the Disc due to the Krullian's urge to find out the gender of Great A'Tuin (the turtle which is swimming through space with four elephants resting the Disc on top).

programme.title: The Colour of Magic
programme.desc: As Rincewind is hounded across the Discworld by the Wizards of Unseen University, he is helped by Twoflower the Tourist, his luggage and Cohen the Barbarian. programme.title: Lone Rider
programme.desc: Bobby Hattaway (Lou Diamond Phillips), an honored soldier, returns home after the American Civil War to find his father's (Stacy Keach) formerly prosperous store now dangerously in debt to the town's ruthless leader, and Bobby's childhood friend, Stu Croker (Vincent Spano). Bobby will now face off against his former friend to take control from Stu.

programme.title: Category 7: The End of the World
programme.desc: Across the world an unprecedented Category 6 storm descends. Violent winds, hurricane-level pressure and unprecedented "tornado alleys" develop across two continents. For years, scientists have been expounding theories - and warnings - of global-warming effects. It's disaster Code Yellow, as the "storm on steroids" is only just beginning to rend the earth.

programme.title: Category 7: The End of the World
programme.desc: The warming effect is creating new regions of extreme weather, but something else is triggering it; something that when combined with record-breaking heat waves creates explosions in the sky. With time running out, discredited scientist Faith Clavell, teams up with storm chaser Tornado Tommy (Emmy nominee Randy Quaid, "Elvis") and Judith to discover the trigger.

programme.title: 10.5: Apocalypse
programme.desc: When a tsunami wipes Waikiki off the map, Dr. Hill's fears about the quake's after-effects are justified. Areas seismically quiet for centuries are awakened: Bald Mountain is engulfed in a deadly cloud of smoke and ash, boiling water rises from the earth, the Hoover Dam crumbles and Mount Rushmore explodes in a fiery burst of molten lava.

programme.title: 10.5: Apocalypse
programme.desc: Las Vegas hotels have sunken into the ground, Dr. Hill and the remaining survivors are racing to escape, Meanwhile, the massive earthquake is threatening to split North America in half and the Nuclear Power plant is right in the path.

programme.title: DC 9/11: Time of Crisis
programme.desc: Gideon Banks lost his wife Liz and son Simon in a horrific car accident some twenty years ago. At the time of the accident he was involved in something called the Neural Archiving Project - NAP for short. The technology was developed to create smart computers - transferring human engrams to computers. The company eventually gave up on the technology, but Gideon didn't. After years of quietly perfecting it, he built a small robot, from parts he stole from Concorde Robotics, where he now works. Zoe, Gideon's niece, discovers Gideon's secret, the robot contains actual neural engrams from the real Simon. She becomes worried not only about Gideon but also about the robot that sounds and acts a lot like her little cousin used to.

programme.title: EuroLeague. Panathinaikos - Fenerbahce
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Olympiacos" - "Anadolu Efes"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

UFC stands for the Ultimate Fighting Championship which is an American mixed martial arts (MMA) promotion company based in Las Vegas that is owned by William Morris Endeavour.The purpose of UFC fighting was to establish the most effective martial art in a contest that had no weight classes and minimal rules that were as follows: no biting, hair pulling, groin shots and eye gouging. Women's MMA has seen Ronda Rousey defend her title from 2012 to 2015 before she was defeated by Holly Holm another belt holder in more than one martial art.

programme.title: Ligue 1. PSG - "Le Mans"
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: When the savannah turns into a battleground, it's hard to choose a hero. We're on the edge of our safari seats as a leopard is cornered by a pride of lions, a young impala is hurled into the air by a hippo and two hyenas try to drown each other. Then, the rarest of sightings as an Aardvark runs for its life from a brown hyaena. Who will win when it's tooth versus claw?

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Life in the African bush is a game of survival, for both hunter and hunted. Add babies to the mix and you'll see astounding feats of courage as mothers risk life and limb to protect their young. In spring, tall grass helps babies hide out of sight, but it also camouflages predators on the prowl. This game drive captures extraordinary behaviour as families and individuals battle to eat, defend, and raise young.

programme.title: Elephant Planet
programme.desc: Across Africa and Asia, four elephant families, following the wisdom of their matriarchal leaders, adapt on the move. Every step tests their instincts and intelligence, as they strive to carry on their legacy by ensuring the newborn's survival. The Samas, a rare herd of desert elephants, endure brutal heat and relentless drought in a desperate search for water. In India, a newborn calf carries the future of the herd as it moves through forests subject to constant environmental changes. On Kenya's savanna, the Tembo family lives alongside deadly predators, struggling to keep their baby safe. And in Borneo, the Gaja herd must navigate a rainforest in flux, adapting to shifting migration paths while teaching their young, inexperienced members the skills they'll need to survive.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Hungry crocs battle a dangerous pod of hippos. The hippos take on a group of male lions. A honey badger battles for life against leopards, and wild dogs cause chaos everywhere they go! In the wilds of Southern Africa, the long, dry winter brings a desperation to the animals who live here. Prepare yourself for a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's summer in Michigan, which means time to bale some hay! It's a grueling process, but Dr. Pol, Charles, and Ben manage to mow their hayfield, which is the first step in baling. But a surprise rainstorm could ruin this year's hay haul. They hope for sun, so their crop doesn't spoil before they can bale. Meanwhile, the Pol's bring in their next animal to the farm - an emu!

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's the county fair season! The Pol's plan to get at least two cows and six sheep at the auction, but they have a lot to do before that can happen. First up, they must install a new perimeter fence. Charles and Ben think they are off to a good start, but when Dr. Pol points out how sneaky sheep can be, their workload doubles. Meanwhile, Beth is hoping for a goat at the small animal auction.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Animals wage a covert war for survival, deploying their hidden weapons with deadly precision. These adaptations, forged by eons of evolution, give animals the edge they need to outwit predators, rivals, and the elements. From the bombardier beetle's boiling spray to the mantis shrimp's explosive club and the draco lizard's hidden wings, meet nature's awesome secret weapons.

Uncover the extraordinary motivations and strategies used by the animal world.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's need to break ground for a new outbuilding that will house incoming livestock and Charles has dreamt up an outrageous idea of what that structure can be - and it just may be just crazy enough to work. At the auction, the Pol's are hoping to purchase sheep and cows, but the skyrocketing bids threaten their big plans.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The bidding is live at the large animal auction! The Pol's are working towards their goal of bringing home sheep and cows to their farm. Any animals they win will be delivered to the farm in just three days, so the pressure is on to get the sheep hut finished in time - and there is a ton left to do. Meanwhile, Beth and Charles are concerned about the low activity in their beehives.

programme.title: Gredos - King of the Mountains
programme.desc: Through the cycle of the seasons, Spain's Sierra de Gredos National Park, one of Europe's most remarkable natural landscapes, is revealed. From ancient glacial cirques and deep mountain ravines to the summit of Almanzor, the highest peak in central Spain, discover a unique and fragile ecosystem. Here, the Spanish ibex, an iconic species that defines the spirit of these mountains, reigns. Alongside it, golden eagles, alpine birds and otters inhabit a territory shaped by isolation and resilience. This is a portrait of wilderness and balance, a window into one of Europe's last great wild spaces.

programme.title: Wild Hunters
programme.desc: Reptiles are extremely efficient hunters, making them as vital to their ecosystems now as they were millions of years ago. Learn how the ancient crocodile has maintained its status as a great aquatic predator.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: The Alps are changing, not in dramatic leaps but in slow, steady shifts. Rising temperatures and decades of human activity are transforming this once-stable mountain region. Ibex, marmots and ptarmigans each face their own challenges in the alpine world, but with change comes new opportunities. How will the different species adapt? In the valleys, the altered flow of rivers threatens bird species that nest on open gravel. Experience a fragile world in motion.

programme.desc: The quiet charm of Germany's Central Uplands lies in ancient forests and wild beauty. Through the autumn forest, the booming call of a stag echoes through the mist. It's rutting season! In Saxon Switzerland, peregrine falcons and black storks inhabit picturesque cliffs. The elusive lynx roams the forests, while in the Harz, a new, wilder forest is growing in the shifting climate.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders
programme.desc: At the western end of the Mediterranean lies Portugal, full of diverse ecosystems that showcase a stunning array of species both big and small, many of which are endemic to the region. Its interconnected web allows each creature a way to survive the rugged landscape. A fire salamander that can live up to 50 years enjoys its first meal after spending a dormant summer underground. One of the rarest wild cats on the planet, the Iberian lynx hunts for its favorite prey: rabbit. Golden eagles and foxes, known to be enemies, tolerate each other for long enough to share their kill. And young Iberian ibex practice for adulthood by knocking their antlers together in an impressive display of strength.

programme.title: Portugal's Wild Wonders
programme.desc: Life on the coast of Portugal is full of beauty and brutality for the unique animals that live there, from the smallest phytoplankton to the giant sperm whales. Fiddler crabs fight for breeding rights in the coastal lagoons. Cuttlefish, the ultimate masters of disguise, creep in on unsuspecting prey. Storks perch precariously on the Atlantic cliffs, protecting their chicks from predators. And sparrowhawks, a top predator endemic to the region, face an uncertain future with human activities and wildfires threatening the youngest generation.

programme.title: Gredos - King of the Mountains
programme.desc: Through the cycle of the seasons, Spain's Sierra de Gredos National Park, one of Europe's most remarkable natural landscapes, is revealed. From ancient glacial cirques and deep mountain ravines to the summit of Almanzor, the highest peak in central Spain, discover a unique and fragile ecosystem. Here, the Spanish ibex, an iconic species that defines the spirit of these mountains, reigns. Alongside it, golden eagles, alpine birds and otters inhabit a territory shaped by isolation and resilience. This is a portrait of wilderness and balance, a window into one of Europe's last great wild spaces.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Great White vs Tiger Shark

But where can we find the world's biggest? And what is it like to meet these massive creatures face-to-face? Join two teams of shark experts on encounters with some of the largest sharks ever caught on camera, including the famed great white Deep Blue.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: The quiet charm of Germany's Central Uplands lies in ancient forests and wild beauty. Through the autumn forest, the booming call of a stag echoes through the mist. It's rutting season! In Saxon Switzerland, peregrine falcons and black storks inhabit picturesque cliffs. The elusive lynx roams the forests, while in the Harz, a new, wilder forest is growing in the shifting climate.

programme.title: Germany's Magic Mountains
programme.desc: The Alps are changing, not in dramatic leaps but in slow, steady shifts. Rising temperatures and decades of human activity are transforming this once-stable mountain region. Ibex, marmots and ptarmigans each face their own challenges in the alpine world, but with change comes new opportunities. How will the different species adapt? In the valleys, the altered flow of rivers threatens bird species that nest on open gravel. Experience a fragile world in motion.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: This family farm needs a barn! The Pols are ready to tackle their next big project: preserving and carefully taking down a 100-year-old barn since, with every piece they remove makes the barn weaker and weaker. There is no room for error if they are going to transport these irreplaceable beams back to the farm and restore it to its former glory.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pols have reached the most dangerous stage of disassembling the 100-year-old barn: taking down the beams. Then, if all goes well, theyll transport the beams back to the farm. Each part of this process must be carefully orchestrated to protect these irreplaceable beams. Meanwhile, Beth tries training Clovis after he runs away from the farm.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Lions kill four buffaloes in a stampede, while in another drying river a buffalo fights off five of the big cats. As the dry winter looms, heading out on a game drive means checking in at all the remaining waterholes. This is where the action plays out. Each event is unpacked and explained, offering a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Panda School
programme.desc: The junior cubs at Panda School are learning essential life skills, and first on the curriculum is chewing bamboo. It's tougher than it looks. Even holding it right is a challenge for most of the cubs. Shy Qing Yang catches on quickest, leaving her twin brother, Can Yang, at the bottom of this class. But he's got other strengths and is soon outsmarting the others with his climbing abilities. Affectionately nicknamed "Dirtbag" is the quietest panda in school, but she's an A student when it comes to balance. She's introverted but self-sufficient, a characteristic that could shape her future. In a special semi-wild enclosure further up the mountain, Tian Tian is raising her cub with the ultimate goal of releasing him into the wild. And there is excitement in the maternity unit as they prepare for the arrival of the next generation.

We're on the edge of our safari seats as a leopard is cornered by a pride of lions, a young impala is hurled into the air by a hippo and two hyenas try to drown each other. Then, the rarest of sightings as an Aardvark runs for its life from a brown hyaena. Who will win when it's tooth versus claw?

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's new livestock aren't potty trained; their sheep hut isn't draining properly and has now been transformed into a Pee Palace. It's late fall and the winter deep freeze is just around the corner, so the family needs to get it fixed fast. The Pol's also get a new sheep for their farm.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol clan gets to work on creating Beth's dream garden. To beat the incoming rainstorm, an exhausted Ben works around the clock to finish building the garden's pond and waterfall. Noticing her brother is near his breaking point, Beth plans a special surprise to lift his spirits.

programme.title: Crocodile - Australia's Greatest Survivor
programme.desc: In Australia, dominant saltwater crocodiles, called ""boss crocs," are the largest and most powerful animals on the continent. Even after unrelenting human pressure on their very survival, they are still the masters of their world. Over the last 200 years, the impact of human activities—such as commercial hunting, agriculture and population growth—pushed them to the brink of extinction. Today, these "boss crocs" have continued to not only survive but thrive.

programme.title: Crocodiles of the Okavango
programme.desc: In Botswana's Okavango Delta, a young Nile crocodile embarks on her first season of motherhood. After winning the chance to breed, she faces fierce competition for nesting territory and the challenge of safeguarding her eggs through months of flooding, searing heat and relentless predators. Monitor lizards, mongooses, baboons and rival crocodiles all threaten her nest while she stands guard. When her hatchlings finally emerge, she carries them to safety in her jaws, but their journey has only begun. In a watery world where even crocodiles prey on their own kind, only a few of her offspring will survive. For this first-time mother, every choice is critical in a nursery where survival is anything but guaranteed.

programme.title: Battle Of the Swamp Dragons
programme.desc: South Florida is the only place on Earth that is home to both the American alligator and the American crocodile (and most recently, the Nile crocodile). But who is the baddest Florida predator? In this croc vs. gator fest, we'll compare the physical characteristics and behavior of these two prehistoric titans in the beautiful backdrop of South Florida to find out who is the true Lord of the Swamp… and identify one species that may threaten his throne.

programme.title: Cave Crocs of Gabon
programme.desc: A caving expedition recently discovered a community of dwarf crocodiles living in the Abanda Caves, Gabon. The crocs are living in pitch darkness, hunt bats and some have bright-orange skin. Part of the original team returns to find out more about this bizarre phenomenon. It's mission impossible to access the crocs world and there's no way of knowing what they might find.

programme.title: Jaguars vs. Crocs
programme.desc: Veteran wildlife photographer Steve Winter and cameraman Bertie Gregory capture the remarkable lives of Jaguars in the Pantanal of Brazil. A mother jaguar teaches her cub survival while a determined male jaguar named Scarface dives headfirst into the river to tackle the deadliest of opponents - 6-foot long caiman. Clever capybaras and playful giant otters stick with their family members to avoid being jaguar dinner.

programme.title: Florida Untamed: Where Reptiles Rule Compilation
programme.desc: Beyond the idyllic beaches and theme parks, there is a battleground where wildlife fights for survival. In ancient cypress swamps and lush mangrove-lined coasts, life-and-death drama unfolds among fearsome reptiles. In the swamps, American alligators reign supreme, while young hatchlings face deadly predators. Along the coastline, crocodiles and eastern diamondback rattlesnake's rule.

programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara
programme.desc: Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way—the Grumeti and the Mara—each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles. In "Croc Wars," follow these ancient predators as they prepare for the feast of the year, but not all crocodiles are created equal. In the deep, fast waters of the Mara, privilege reigns, kills come easy, and food is plentiful. In the rugged Grumeti, crocodiles must outwit, adapt and fight for every scrap. From brutal ambushes to stolen kills, this is a high-stakes battle for survival on two rivers with two strategies and only one chance to eat.

programme.title: Built for the Kill
programme.desc: The crocodile is the world's largest reptilian predator, but it takes years of intensive training to learn to be lethal. It enters the world as a replica of its adult form, only four thousand times smaller. Built for the Kill: Crocodile follows the transformation of a tiny hatchling into an accomplished killer, exposing real life-and-death struggles in dramatic second-by-second detail.

programme.title: Tucci Italijoje
programme.desc: Amerikiečių aktorius Stanley Tucci - vienas įvairiapusiškiausių žmonių Holivude. Iš Italijos kilęs vyras kino filmuose nesunkiai gali persikūnyti į žudiką, aukštosios mados dizainerį, linksmą sutuoktinį, landų žurnalistą, piktą žmogų ar keistuolį. Už filmavimo aikštelės ribų - jis gyvenimu besidžiaugiantis žmogus, su puikiu humoro jausmu ir didžiule meile gardžiam maistui. Tad ne nuostabu, kad jis kviečia žiūrovus atrasti tikrąją Italiją. Italijos regionų išskirtinumą, kuris geriausiai atsiskleidžia ruošiamuose patiekaluose. Stanley mėgaujasi maisto meniškumu vaizdingoje Toskanoje, aplanko Florenciją ir Sieną. Pasineria į kulinarinio kūrybiškumo dvasią Renesanso gimtinėje. Italijos pramoninėje šiaurėje Stanley tyrinėja novatorišką virtuvę ir futuristinį ūkininkavimą. Italijos vokiškai kalbančioje šiaurėje Stanley tyrinėja dvigubą kultūrinį tapatumą per šieno sriubą, slidinėjimą Dirndlio dieną, polentą kalnų šlaituose ir žvejybą ledyninėse upėse, ir tyrinėja, kaip istorinė pasienio įtampa formavo vietos virtuvę ir kultūrą. Šiame nelygiame regione Stanley tyrinėja, kaip reljefas formuoja maisto kultūrą. Jis kepa avieną ant grotelių avių ūkyje, mėgaujasi prancūziško stiliaus sekmadienio pietumis ir atskleidžia saldžią konfeti istoriją, atskleisdamas netikėtų kulinarinių malonumų.

programme.title: Rock, Paper, Scissors

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Raph is freaking out! He wanted to fight everyone, but now he's up against his brothers, and it's the worst. Kitsune and her gang the Purple Dragons captured Mikey, Donnie, and Leo and used mind control devices to send them into the Mutant Battle Arena. They chase Raph through the arena and out to the street where he uses the Turtle Tank as a getaway car. Raph realizes he's in too deep and must turn to an unlikely source for help - the snobby Pigeon Pete! Together, they form a multi-step plan in which Pete will steal the mind control devices right from under the Purple Dragons' noses while Raph distracts all the Mutants in the arena. But things don't go quite as planned and it's up to Raph to save everyone he loves! Can he find a way to disarm the mind control devices and save everyone before it's too late?

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Ray Fillet is attacked in Central Park by a mutant turtle! Donnie's busy with his robotics project: turning Metalhead into a spider-bot. Wingnut bursts in and tells the Turtles to come quick- Ray is hurt! A woozy Ray blames the Ninja Turtles, and the Mutanimals start a fight with the confused brothers. But when Ray's REAL attacker appears, a mutant snapping turtle named TOKKA, he fights everyone... until his watch starts beeping and he escapes. The Turtles tail him, ending up on the Staten Island ferry. After a big fight, Tokka's trapped. But while questioning him, Tokka explodes into OOZE, leaving only a baby turtle and his watch. Donnie's brothers ask him to hack it and find clues about Tokka, which he says is impossible! Later, Donnie gets a location pin from Wingnut and follows it to an abandoned factory on Staten Island. He finds her and ANOTHER TOKKA that he cleverly takes out! Donnie thinks they're safe until MORE Monster Mutanimals emerge! Could Donnie's day get any worse?

programme.title: The Twisted Timeline of Sammy and Raj
programme.desc: Everyone in town is shimmying to the latest Bollywood dance trend: The Tavish Twist! Raj loves it, but Sammy is not so keen.// When Dada's manuscript goes missing, it's up to Sammy, Raj and Tara to find out "who dun it?".

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: Invictus - L'invincibile
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige Morgan Freeman e Matt Damon in un biopic sportivo. Sudafrica, 1995. Per il presidente Mandela, la coppa del mondo di rugby è l'occasione per unire bianchi e neri.

programme.title: L'attachement: La tenerezza
programme.desc: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi in un emozionante film premiato con 3 César. Accudendo i figli del vicino di casa, colpito da un grave lutto, Sandra scopre la forza del legame familiare.

programme.title: La terra promessa
programme.desc: Basato su una storia vera, Nikolaj Arcel torna a dirigere Mads Mikkelsen. 1755: Ludvig von Kahlen vuole rendere coltivabile la brughiera ma deve vedersela con uno spietato latifondista.

programme.title: Il pescatore di sogni
programme.desc: Lasse Hallstrom dirige una commedia con Ewan McGregor ed Emily Blunt. Uno sceicco yemenita convince un esperto di pesca al salmone a diffondere questa pratica sportiva in Medio Oriente.

programme.title: Old Man & the Gun
programme.desc: Robert Redford, Casey Affleck e Sissy Spacek nella biografia di un rapinatore ‘gentiluomo’. Il film racconta la vita di Forrest Tucker, autore di un numero imprecisato di rapine in banca. Un criminale seriale che ha affascinato l’opinione pubblica e che si è reso protagonista di numerose evasioni, persino dopo aver superato i 70 anni quando scappò addirittura dal penitenziario di San Quintino. Sulle sue tracce un detective; al suo fianco una donna che lo amava nonostante tutto. La sceneggiatura, firmata dal regista David Lowery, è ispirata a un reportage apparso su The New Yorker nel 2003.

programme.title: Full Metal Jacket (Edizione Deluxe)
programme.desc: La 'sporca guerra' secondo Stanley Kubrick in un film epocale con Matthew Modine. Al campo di addestramento di Parris Island il severissimo sergente di ferro Hartman addestra diciassette reclute a diventare spietati marines: i suoi metodi, durissimi e mortificanti, sono in grado di trasformare i soldati in vere e proprie macchine da guerra, pronte per affrontare l'orrore del conflitto in Vietnam. Come il soldato Joker e il soldato Cowboy che si ritroveranno al fronte, nel cuore del paese di Ho Chi Minh, nel mirino di un misterioso cecchino viet cong.

programme.title: L'ora più buia
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Gary Oldman nel film che racconta i primi turbolenti giorni da Primo Ministro di Winston Churchill. Nel 1940, il celebre statista inglese deve affrontare l'avanzata dei nazisti e prendere decisioni drammatiche per il bene del suo paese, ma deve fare i conti con lo scettico re e con alcuni membri del suo partito che sembrano tramare contro di lui. Oscar anche al trucco. La pellicola è stato candidata anche per la sceneggiatura, scritta da Anthony McCarten che aveva firmato anche un altro fortunato biopic, “La teoria del tutto”.

programme.title: The Lost King
programme.desc: Stephen Frears dirige Sally Hawkins e Steve Coogan in un film Sky Original. Ispirata dal Riccardo III shakespeariano, una donna si mette alla ricerca delle perdute spoglie del sovrano.

programme.desc: Siamo nei primi anni 50, Eddie Mannix è impegnato a risolvere tutti i problemi degli attori e registi della Capitol Pictures. I suoi ultimi incarichi comprendono un regista scontento, un cowboy cantante, un bel nuotatore e un affascinante ballerino.

programme.title: Il pescatore di sogni
programme.desc: Lasse Hallstrom dirige una commedia con Ewan McGregor ed Emily Blunt. Uno sceicco yemenita convince un esperto di pesca al salmone a diffondere questa pratica sportiva in Medio Oriente.

programme.title: Alexander
programme.desc: Oliver Stone dirige Colin Farrell nel kolossal che racconta l'ascesa e il tragico destino di Alessandro Magno, il glorioso condottiero che conquisto' tutto il mondo conosciuto.

programme.title: Honey Don't!
programme.desc: Ethan Coen dirige una sensuale Margaret Qualley, detective privata fuori dagli schemi di un intrigante noir ambientato in California.

programme.title: Il professore e il pinguino
programme.desc: Un insegnante di inglese disilluso si reca in Argentina nel 1976 per insegnare. Si trova di fronte a una classe di ragazzi turbolenti e a un Paese nel caos. Quando salva un pinguino da una spiaggia inquinata dal petrolio, tutto cambia.

programme.title: I figli degli uomini
programme.desc: Sci-Fi distopico di Alfonso Cuaron, con Clive Owen, Julianne Moore e Michael Caine. 2027: un ex attivista protegge l'unica donna rimasta incinta in un'umanita' colpita dall'infertilita'.

programme.title: Il quadro rubato
programme.desc: André Masson, esperto di arte moderna, riceve una lettera in cui si dice che un dipinto di Egon Schiele è stato trovato a Mulhouse. Dell'opera era scomparsa ogni traccia ormai dal 1939.

programme.title: Il colosso di Rodi
programme.desc: Lo spettacolare esordio alla regia di Sergio Leone. Sull'isola greca un gruppo di congiurati si ribella contro il Re Serse, mentre i Fenici stanno per attaccare la citta'.

programme.title: Laggiù qualcuno mi ama
programme.desc: Ritratto di Massimo Troisi in un documentario di Mario Martone. Le tante sfaccettature dell'indimenticato artista partenopeo attraverso materiali inediti e testimonianze di chi lo ha amato.

programme.title: Boy Erased - Vite cancellate
programme.desc: Nicole Kidman, Lucas Hedges e Russell Crowe in una sconvolgente storia vera. Il figlio di un predicatore confessa la propria omosessualita' e viene iscritto a un programma riabilitativo.

programme.title: The Post
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg dirige Meryl Streep e Tom Hanks in un capolavoro sulla libertà di stampa. 1971: il Washington Post entra in possesso di documenti del Pentagono sulla guerra in Vietnam.

programme.title: Monsieur Aznavour
programme.desc: Tahar Rahim (Il profeta) è Charles Aznavour. Dalla difficile infanzia nella Parigi popolare all’incontro con Édith Piaf, il viaggio umano e artistico di un’icona senza tempo.

programme.title: I figli degli uomini
programme.desc: Sci-Fi distopico di Alfonso Cuaron, con Clive Owen, Julianne Moore e Michael Caine. 2027: un ex attivista protegge l'unica donna rimasta incinta in un'umanita' colpita dall'infertilita'.

programme.title: Romanzo criminale
programme.desc: Michele Placido dirige Favino, Rossi Stuart, Accorsi, Scamarcio, Santamaria, Fresi e Germano per raccontare ascesa e caduta della Banda della Magliana nell'Italia degli anni 70.

programme.title: L'ultimo turno
programme.desc: Leonie Benesch (La sala professori) in un film presentato alla Berlinale. In un ospedale sotto organico, un'infermiera giovane, abile e disponibile affronta un turno estenuante.

programme.title: Sully
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige un intenso biopic con Tom Hanks. Dopo aver salvato i passeggeri del suo aereo con una coraggiosa manovra, nel 2009 il capitano Sullenberger fu messo sotto accusa.

programme.title: Nord Sud Ovest Est: La leggendaria...
programme.desc: Dopo “Hanno Ucciso l'Uomo Ragno”, la storia di Max e Mauro continua: la loro prima estate da cantanti famosi sta finendo e arrivano nuove sfide e nuove scelte.

programme.title: Nord Sud Ovest Est: La leggendaria...
programme.desc: Max e Mauro devono gestire la nuova notorietà e le improvvise apparizioni di Silvia, proprio quando la mitica Michela Rossini propone a Max un primo appuntamento.

programme.title: Chi segna vince
programme.desc: Commedia sportiva dell'ironico Taika Waititi con Michael Fassbender. Dopo un'umiliante sconfitta, la nazionale delle Samoa Americane ingaggia un nuovo allenatore.

programme.title: Nord Sud Ovest Est: La leggendaria...
programme.desc: Dopo “Hanno Ucciso l'Uomo Ragno”, la storia di Max e Mauro continua: la loro prima estate da cantanti famosi sta finendo e arrivano nuove sfide e nuove scelte.

programme.desc: Max e Mauro devono gestire la nuova notorietà e le improvvise apparizioni di Silvia, proprio quando la mitica Michela Rossini propone a Max un primo appuntamento.
